storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Taken from the slums as a child, she is forced to live as the son of a noble house while hiding who she really is.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Years of lies never erase the girl she remembers, and reclaiming that life becomes the only fight that matters.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A princess finds a mysterious book whose events start matching reality, including a doomed double who shares her name.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Convinced she is the imposter the plot will execute, she races to break the remaining pages before fate catches up.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Facing his mother's death, a son trades years of his own life so she can live again.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She wakes as a young college student while he spends what time he has left making her happy, until a friend falls for her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A wild girl with unusual eyes and a tiny dragon is found in a ruined palace and claimed as long-lost royalty.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: An emperor and his other children try to draw her into the family while wondering whether her sight of hidden things will bless or break the realm.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: At the peak of a cutthroat company, a lonely executive drinks and wishes he could undo the past.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wakes decades younger at the start of his career, armed with future knowledge and determined to fix toxic culture and broken relationships.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: At school, a disabled student is treated as a target by classmates and teachers alike.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A quiet transfer student refuses to leave his side, forcing him to decide whether trust is worth the risk.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Chaos among self-proclaimed chosen heroes has lasted for decades, and one disciple with many masters inherits the burden of fixing it.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He swears to cut through heaven's favorites, but first he has to deal with a body that is nowhere near as sharp as his resolve.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A busy career woman with a new home and a mountain of chores swears she does not need a man complicating things.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A desperate stranger offers housework for a place to stay, claiming he is no romantic threat, until feelings and that lie start colliding.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Returning a lost wallet starts a charged connection between a student and a beautiful stranger.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She turns out to be his future homeroom teacher, and both of them have a warped sense of justice that makes the classroom dangerous.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A shy boy with a delicate face is constantly mistaken for a girl and never manages to speak to his crush.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Sharing a classroom with the most popular student only deepens the gap between wanting closeness and being too timid to ask for it.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A loyal worker is murdered by the conglomerate he served, then wakes years earlier inside the founder's bloodline.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He uses future knowledge to settle scores and aim a hostile takeover at the empire that discarded him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young fighter rises through a ruthless martial sect until elite assassin work still is not enough.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Decades of sword and inner energy training push him toward a legendary realm few in his order have ever reached.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A drunk blurt of affection lands on the wrong man and ruins a transplanted woman's plan for a quiet fantasy life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Caught between healing duties in a wartime court and two compelling knights, she has to untangle feelings she never meant to start.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After winning a long war, a commander expects gold and instead is ordered to pick a noble husband from a list.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She chooses a disgraced imperial son figuring he will buy his way out, but he accepts the marriage and offers help rebuilding her ruined house for reasons of his own.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: On the eve of a wedding meant to escape her tormentors, a girl is flung back into the childhood she hoped to forget.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: What starts as payback against the household's three sons slowly turns into understanding the pain on both sides.

entries.title: The Red Knight Seeks No Reward

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A bounty-chasing fighter dies for greed and wakes years earlier determined to become a knight worth the title.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She joins an honorable order known for its crimson colors, hoping discipline can scrub out the wrongs of the life she already lived.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A martial ruler who fought with bare hands falls to demonic rivals and wakes in a wild merchant heir's body.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Past-life technique plus new family wealth become tools for getting strong enough to settle every unpaid debt of blood.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A veteran's last obstacle course goes lethal after a fall, and a goddess offers him a heroic second life he never asked for.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Dumped into survival with divine schemes still running, he crosses paths with another goddess, a spy, and someone from his old unit.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Dropped into another world as a despised noble daughter, she leans on the cooking craft that once saved her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Fine-tuned taste and kitchen skill become her path to status in a society that crowns culinary excellence as real power.

entries.title: The Dang Clan’s Swordmaster Heir Just Wants a Normal Life

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An outcast boy in a fading house of poisons and hidden weapons suddenly remembers a past life spent mastering the blade.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wants an ordinary existence, but protecting what remains of his family keeps pulling him back into the martial world.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Dropped into a cultivator's world with six others, he looks talentless while they shine.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Death only sends him back to the beginning, and the loop he cannot escape becomes both his only gift and the cage he wants to break.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Fame finally arrives, but the cost is the parent he failed, and despair sends him back to childhood.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He swears off the stage to be a better son until poverty returns, forcing him toward the set one more time.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After saving the world from rifts and horrors, a top-ranked fighter wakes years later presumed dead and craving a quiet job.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Managing a hangover soup spot is not enough when relics of his past keep selling and the nation's strongest starts watching him too closely.

entries.title: How to survive as a maid in a horror game

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After grinding a notoriously unfair murder mystery title, a player wakes inside it as household staff.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The young master she serves is destined to slaughter everyone under a curse, and staying alive means rewriting a script built for massacre.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Peace returns after a truce between hellish and heavenly realms, until an ordinary student touches a wartime relic and remembers who he used to be.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Old power rushes back with new tricks attached, and he has to decide whether a former destroyer can keep the calm world standing.

entries.title: Precious Daughter of the Greatest Martial Arts Villain

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A gentle girl wakes up as the child of a feared martial warlord whose enemies are already closing in.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She knows the story ends with revenge against her family, and tries to slip free of that doomed fate before it arrives.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After dying from overwork, a student wakes as a gifted noble child everyone expects to excel.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She looks for a softer path through magic that leans on companions instead of endless study, only to find that shortcut carries its own dangers.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A prisoner branded a killer and a witch is suddenly released into a powerful noble's care.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Under kinder tutelage she recovers her strength and becomes a wild card in a ruthless contest for the empire's future.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A fighter who cleared one story's final threat wakes up trapped inside a second novel instead of going home.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Framed for murder as a petty noble villainess, she still has combat skills nobody expects, and must clear her name if she ever wants out.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After her father is killed and her lover turns on her, a new ruler must marry to lock down her throne.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She gathers several partners from very different backgrounds instead of picking one consort, while still hunting for the truth behind the assassination.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A warrior who watched his world die finds a second chance on a quieter Earth that has not yet fallen.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Bound by a promise to protect the family of the body he now wears, he takes up his blade again as monsters begin to appear.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A naturally charming young woman keeps drawing unwanted attention from other women, including her closest friend.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: That friend's unstable suitors declare war on her as competition, forcing her to outmaneuver them without getting killed.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An awkward teen with almost no confidence spends her days studying alone and wondering why nobody asks her out.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Joining a quirky, welcoming art club pushes her to find who she is beyond grades and empty evenings.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young man has spent his life dreaming of a masked board game he was skilled at but never won.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When that game spills into waking life and people become pieces, his half-finished dream memories may be humanity's only edge.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A reader who hated a cruel noblewoman's plot wakes up wearing that villain's face.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She tries to undo the conditioning done to a captive boy, only to find one kiss has already nudged the story off its rails.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ordinary high schooler learns he is half demon and heir to a bloodline he never knew existed.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: In a darker realm, a contest for the throne begins, and his newly revealed heritage pulls him into that fight.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: To spare her family, a woman takes a high-pressure post beside a feared ruler she plans to leave once the job is done.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When she asks to resign, he refuses in a way that makes escape feel as dangerous as staying.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A born fighter swears off violence for his mother's sake, even when it means taking hits.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After his father dies with a message to stop being a punching bag, that promise starts to crack.

entries.title: Reborn as the Overpowered Genius Lord

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A battlefield orphan dies regretting unfinished talent, then wakes as a child in a household of prodigies.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Rather than specialize like his relatives, he tries to master every path at once and finally grow into what he never could before.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A debt-ridden gym owner gets pulled into a martial arts fantasy while reading a novel.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Stuck as a young temple trainee, he leans on modern workout know-how to survive brutal drills and find a way home.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a ruined world overrun by the undead, a survivor gets sent back to months before the outbreak began.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Stockpiling gear only goes so far when gangs rise and the timeline stops matching what he remembers.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An author dies at the end of a story and wakes inside the body of a tragic villain nobody ever understood.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Facing a ruined family and a revenge plot headed for catastrophe, he sets out to rewrite that ending from the inside.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A bedridden reader whose favorite story ends in total ruin wakes up as a forgotten side character inside it.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Determined to force a kinder finale than the hero wrote in blood, he starts changing events from the margins.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A struggling graduate student's life flips when a child he never knew he had arrives asking for a home.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Parenting is chaotic, yet luck, school, and even his health start improving in ways that feel almost unnatural.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A historian digs into how a notorious procrastinator somehow became a revered martial legend.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The path to greatness always seemed to start tomorrow, and the truth behind that reputation is stranger than the myths.

entries.title: The Adventures of a Demon King's Daughter

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Given a second life in a fantasy world, a girl finds herself born to a feared ruler of the underworld.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With mismatched celestial and demonic guardians watching over her, she grows up amid mischief, politics, and threats aimed at her father.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A cursed imperial line only breaks its doom when a girl is born into the bloodline.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A slave child with the family's telltale eyes is declared a princess, and the cold princes who claim her may finally learn how to feel again.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Bullied at school and mocked in a VR game as a weak healer, a teen hides a second login that plays like a different person entirely.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A logout glitch dumps that hidden avatar's power into reality, forcing him to fight monsters while still surviving campus life.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A loyal soldier realizes too late that the ruler he served had been controlling his mind.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Death fails to stick: he wakes years earlier in training, free to choose revenge, family, or both.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A brilliant corporate climber is reassigned as aide to the heir she has quietly outshone for years.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He has resented her since training ranked her above him, yet cannot stop circling her even as the job traps them together.

entries.title: Forget My Husband, I'll Go Make Money

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A long-imprisoned princess hides a rare gift for seeing across time that her father wants to seize.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Sent to an enemy realm as a marriage pawn meant to spark war, she plans to fund her own freedom instead.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A man who cannot ignore injustice dies protecting a neighbor from dangerous strangers.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Three days later he wakes alive again, and the plot around her turns out far bigger than a street crime.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Invisible at school but legendary inside a popular virtual world, a quiet teen finally gets noticed.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Beating a bully in a tournament earns him a spot at an elite academy as the line between game and reality starts to blur.

entries.title: Too Many Heroes for the Demon Lord

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A once by-the-book dark ruler gets a second life and vows to smash every rule that led him to ruin.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A bungled royal kidnapping throws that plan into chaos, and an entire continent's champions seem ready to answer.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An aging steward dies in a burning castle and wakes as the young, useless lord he once served.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Armed with real estate craft and hard-won experience, he tries to save the domain from a ruthless imperial relative.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A sickly heir of a powerful house has never had friends beyond the maid she secretly loves.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She does not know her family ruined that maid's life, and affection may turn into a deadly reckoning.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A high schooler flung into another realm is taken in by a duke, then offered up as an aging ruler's concubine.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When that ruler is assassinated, she must survive a poisonous contest among rivals for the empty throne.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young man spends years preparing to avenge the people a criminal syndicate stole from him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The group that killed his father and mentor still gathers in a luxury hotel, and he knows exactly who he needs to bring them down.

entries.title: A Royal Princess with Black Hair

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Two royal teens forced into a political marriage are determined to make each other beg for a divorce.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Outside enemies plot to tear them apart for real, and surviving those schemes slowly softens their rivalry.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An abused illegitimate noble daughter is shipped off to wed a dead traitor in place of her sister, and she is glad to leave.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The husband returns alive, claiming he was framed, and she agrees to help clear his name despite the danger ahead.

entries.title: Barbarian's Adventure in a Fantasy World

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A warrior raised among monsters on a frozen waste finally reaches the civilized lands he always dreamed of.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Polite curiosity and overwhelming strength confuse everyone who expected a mindless brute, and the quests he wanted get stranger for it.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: On a rough street rattled by a string of killings, a struggling tenant is too busy surviving to care.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A peculiar new neighbor invites him to dinner, and what he finds during the meal puts the murders much too close.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A useless human prince contracts with a demon sovereign and dies on the spot, leaving the demon stuck in his body.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Bound to finish the prince's last wishes or never reclaim his true form, he trains, fights angels, and races a ticking clock.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A failed trader dies saving a child and wakes fourteen years earlier with every market memory intact.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His family's finances are collapsing, so he uses foresight from a future that already happened to rewrite their luck.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A new monarch has the throne, vengeance, and the person he loves, yet that love still feels like spoils of war.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Court uncertainty and a brewing second coup force the pair to hold both the crown and each other.

entries.title: Ian the Illegitimate Son Was an Emperor

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Betrayed on the brink of death, a mage-emperor is flung a century into the past by forbidden magic.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Waking as a margrave's bastard about to be traded to a desert tribe, he must gather allies before history repeats.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An heir to a demonic martial order flees betrayal by leaping into another body far in the future.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Isolated and hunted, he can finally cultivate for the first time, and will do anything to protect the master who raised him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Crushed by bullying and grief, a young man is ready to end his life when a grim reaper offers a contract instead.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He can borrow the power of the dead, but each use spends years of his remaining lifespan.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Orphans are polished into perfect foster children for wealthy clients who expect something far darker than adoption.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Under elite instructors, innocence becomes a weapon, and perfection comes at a price few guardians can afford.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A former outsider watches a friend suffer a horrific attack and decides quiet endurance is no longer enough.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: An ability he never knew he had becomes the tool for revenge against the people who ruined that life.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After the world falls, surviving humans live under the rule of hybrid undead who evolved past the outbreak.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A ragtag resistance of powered fighters finds a boy who cannot die, and that changes the odds against total domination.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A composed upperclassman hides a flashy online persona that thrives on pricey virtual costumes.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He connects with a deep-pocketed first-year who has secrets of his own, and affection turns risky both on campus and in-game.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ex-idol trainee hides his famous face behind glasses, hoping for an ordinary school life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Without looks to lean on, making friends is awkward, his seatmate never smiles, and fans still track him down.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After decades of brutal training for a VR world, a fighter finally leaves the tutorial ready for anything.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The game resets him to the bottom and marks him as prey, while a dying master's wish still demands he become the realm's most feared villain.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A vice chairman and his longtime aide have been an unbeatable office pair for nearly a decade, until she suddenly resigns.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Learning she wants to leave to find a husband, he offers himself as the solution, only to discover she is not interested.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A disabled survivor of a village raid keeps training for martial arts even though everyone insists he never will.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With a lame leg treated as the worst condition a fighter can have, he still refuses to abandon the dream of becoming the best.

entries.title: I Woke Up as the Ugly Duckling

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reborn as a noble daughter branded the family shame, she opens her eyes years before the life that ended in exile and despair.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She stops chasing approval and prepares to survive alone among demons and thieves, only for the people who once ignored her to suddenly take interest.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A summoned savior from another world is cast aside, then returns with allies only to be betrayed at the brink of victory.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A decade later he comes back to the same continent and finds an unexpected partner in the daughter of the ruler he once fought.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An overlooked fighter finally meets a ruler who values hard work as much as she does.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: They set out to unify a continent together, until he realizes the person fighting at his side has also claimed his heart.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The only awakened without a celestial mark somehow lands the finishing blow against a world-ending threat.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A goddess grants his wish to go back and prevent the tragedy, but his body rejects the borrowed mark and the catastrophe returns with him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A couple looks completely uninterested in each other from the outside.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Small sparks of chemistry keep surfacing, and their cool distance slowly turns into something warmer.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Childhood friends share a bond complicated by the fact that one is human and the other is a werewolf bound to protect her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: As werewolves gain uneven rights in society, their growing romance clashes with how the world still treats them as exotic beasts.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reborn into luxury as a count's daughter, she suddenly has only two weeks to secure a marriage or lose her inheritance.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She seeks a holy fighter at the temple and finds a cold commander who looks perfect on paper yet wants nothing to do with her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a violent crime leaves him housebound and afraid of the outside, a young man gains the power to create copies of himself.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With a day left before a portal claims him, he sends a double through while his real body stays home, turning survival into a remote adventure.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A top-ranked game player is murdered by his trusted leader and wakes years in the past.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He rejoins with a class that rewards killing other players, knowing that dying in the game means dying for real.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A dying reader wakes as a novel's doomed antagonist and races to exit the plot path that kills her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She dumps the cursed love interest who needs a constant scent to stay sane, only for him to cling harder once she tries to leave.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A girl who spent years proving she belonged after a birth switch loses everything when the true heir resurfaces.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With her perfect-daughter reputation ruined overnight, she turns her anger on the family that never valued her and the sister taking her place.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Familiar horror tales get retold from a perspective most listeners never hear.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The narrators are the spirits themselves, offering chills that ordinary campfire versions never quite reach.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After losing everything to a worthless parent, a woman wakes in the body of a newborn royal.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A doting new family and imperial power finally feel like safety, until a prophecy paints a target on her peaceful second life.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A boy's fate begins to shift after he receives a gift from a guardian deity.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: What starts as a quiet blessing pulls him into a larger fantasy destiny he never asked for.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A boy who dreamed of becoming a hunter loses everything when bullies destroy his family.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Crushed and trapped after a failed attempt at payback, he returns as something far more feral than the fighters who broke him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A dying sect leader realizes he never lived the life he wanted and wakes again as a child.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: This time he aims for honor among the very alliance that opposed his old order, starting as a puny kid who must learn their ways from scratch.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A side character blessed with an angelic face already knows how a romance novel ends.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When the story's villain takes a liking to her, she must choose whose side to play while juggling suitors and a dragon boy she somehow has to manage.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a martial world, a fighter trains under a brutal grandfather and sets out seeking both strength and a partner.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His path centers on archery that strikes beyond ordinary sight, a ki technique meant to outshine even famed blade guidance.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A new college student moves into an apartment building and finds an unexpected neighbor with a hidden past.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The woman living below him is a former celebrity in hiding, and curiosity pulls him into her room before he understands what that means.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: At the turn of a century, an heiress and her stern husband struggle to save a failing luxury hotel through a cold marriage of duty.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her growing attachment to a handsome servant twists the arrangement, forcing her to weigh desire against family survival and business reputation.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After years of abuse as an adopted noble child, a tragedy sends her back to age eight with a chance to escape.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A potion reveals she belongs to a powerful duke's bloodline, even as he insists she cannot possibly be his.

entries.title: My Civil Servant Life Reborn in the Strange World

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A man who promised his dying mother a respectable career gets trucked into a fantasy world instead.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Reborn as a fearsome tribe's magic heir, he flees to the capital chasing desk work while family, roommates, and a coup plot refuse to leave him alone.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A rare fire witch is betrayed and killed by the prince she loved, then wakes as a newborn imperial princess.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With royal blood and overwhelming strength, she hides her magic, gathers allies, and aims for the throne by outlasting a crowd of siblings.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman who can hear spirits moves into a new house determined to ignore the resident one.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The lonely ghost wants company after years of silence, and she reluctantly agrees to share the house for a year.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Campus relationships that looked settled enter a more complicated second chapter.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Old tensions between a cautious student and a calculating upperclassman resurface as trust, jealousy, and half-truths keep shifting.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A man wakes in another world with a support class and no idea how to get home.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His status calls him a healer, yet he has zero healing skills, so survival means improvising while he searches for a way back.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A battered high schooler is offered a briefcase of cash by a man in a suit.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He takes the deal as a chance to stop holding back and settle old scores with his fists.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A bullied student accidentally frees a sealed vampire who latches onto her like an overeager pet.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His manic energy becomes an unlikely shield against school torment, turning a horror premise into something oddly comforting.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reborn in the body of a notorious wicked noblewoman, she must honor a demonic marriage contract to reclaim her life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The catch is her health drains with every step, so she races a ticking clock while a purely political engagement starts feeling personal.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young man who sees spirits thinks he understands the supernatural until something far holier appears.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After accidentally damaging a celestial visitor's wing, he is stuck looking after a handsome otherworldly roommate.

entries.title: Can't See Can't Hear But Love

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An artist wonders whether quitting his craft would have spared his sight.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Losing that sense is also how he meets someone who changes what love means when communication itself becomes harder.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A clan heir with a blocked energy flow and a shortened lifespan lives quietly indoors until assassins shatter that peace.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After losing someone like a sister in the ambush, he grabs a rusted blade in a sealed passage and chooses to die fighting rather than run further.

entries.title: The Count's Youngest Son is a Gamer

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A top-ranked virtual player is killed over a mythical find and wakes inside an earlier version of the same world.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Now trapped as a minor noble with no other players around, he uses old-world knowledge to save a failing house and unlock powers that should not exist yet.

entries.title: Leveling Up My Husband to the Max

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: At the moment of a wrongful execution, a noble wife is thrown ten years into her past.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Facing a younger version of the cold spouse who once ruined her, she finds him strangely devoted and sets out to rewrite their miserable marriage.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A brawny border prince with imperial ambitions needs brains he does not have.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He recruits a master of disguise whose life hangs on pulling off her boldest scam: posing as his noble partner while enemies circle them both.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a world where androids are ordinary housemates, a young man ends up living with two built by his sister.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: One is framed as a bodyguard with lethal strength, and he only learns why he needed protection the hard way.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A craftsman hides among menial jobs in a world of monster dungeons, only lending gear when someone truly needs it.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: That habit draws mega guilds and killers tied to heroes from a past life, forcing him to forge his way through a conspiracy that followed him here.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A college student obsessed with a pay-to-win collector game dies right after landing a top-tier character.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wakes as a disposable starter fighter who can learn any skill, armed with game knowledge in a magic-ravaged version of the city he knew.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A novel-obsessed reader wakes inside the story as the villain doomed to die.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After dying enough times that waiting it out fails, she throws away the script and decides to survive on her own terms.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a long engagement that never felt right, a woman walks away and tries to start over abroad.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A ruler who wants to give her the affection she never received appears just as she is learning how to live without that old winter of duty.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reincarnated as a novel villainess fated to die by the male lead's hand, she tries to befriend him instead.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He is a rare mage who can sense and control thoughts, yet her mind is the one he cannot read, pulling them into a strained friendship that may rewrite the ending.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An orphan adopted by a wealthy duke spends years trying to earn a father's love that never comes.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Used as a stand-in for a dying heiress until the real daughter recovers, she dies discarded, then wakes at age eight done playing nice.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A former intern who abandoned medicine to care for his mother gets a second chance after a freak accident.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: An artificial network fused into his body grants sharpened senses and vast medical knowledge, but one wrong cut still costs a life.

entries.title: The Regressed Demon Lord Is Kind

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A feared dark ruler falls to a hero and hears one last request: if reborn, try being a good person.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Awake in his younger body, he genuinely wants to change, yet he has no idea what kindness actually looks like in practice.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a car accident dumps her into another world, a woman is sold into a noble household under a dangerous false identity.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The master who bought her is the realm's sole blood drinker, and serving him closely starts shifting how he looks at her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Family duty pulls a stressed city student into the countryside for what should be quiet fresh air.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Awkward misunderstandings with a rustic neighbor keep stacking until prickly distance turns into something neither planned.

entries.title: I Didn't Mean to Seduce the Male Lead!

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A novelist hired as a relationship expert is tasked with steering a stubborn noble toward a royal marriage.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He ignores the princess and falls for the matchmaker instead, leaving her caught between an angry father and a two-faced rival.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a frontier where an empire never fell, martial power is used to squeeze people dry, and settlers flee to a newly found continent.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A reincarnated modern man finds the local fighting arts crude compared to the novels he loved, and sets out to teach a more refined path across the wilds.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A being crafted by alchemy centuries ago starts living with a writer in exchange for telling his story.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Through everyday companionship he slowly learns what it means to be human, while she realizes he has changed her life without either of them planning it.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A noble daughter who survived being offered as a sacrifice keeps traveling in search of the man who sold her out.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She journeys with her maid, gifts a rare altar stone to a stranger who vows repayment, and keeps hunting the father whose past sins still haunt her.

entries.title: The Unorthodox Genius of the House of Darkness

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A fallen hero who failed to stop the world's end wakes up in the body of a despised outsider with only a few years left.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Saving everyone means climbing to the throne from within the very bloodline he once fought, before the clock runs out.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A mercenary sister who bled for medicine remembers a past life where she was the villain of her sibling's story.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Rather than play the wicked role again, she picks up her weapon to shield the girl from every hardship the original plot still intends.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A sealed dark overlord wakes up trapped in an infant's body inside the heart of a sacred empire.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He cannot walk or talk yet, but loyal followers still move in the shadows while he plots payback against the gods who sealed him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A toddler lost after her mother vanishes stumbles into the estate of a feared noble of demonic blood.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A prophetic book warns an adopted girl will replace a dead child of the house, so she decides to live boldly while she still can.

entries.title: A Common Story of a Lady's New Life

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A reincarnated woman expected genius magic and instead settles for the most ordinary life she can manage.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: An unwanted engagement, a rival favored by the household, and a prince who will not back off keep dragging her back into noble chaos.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Down on her luck and furious, a woman sets out to destroy the country's biggest star.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The closer she gets to the man behind the fame, the harder it becomes to finish the ruin she planned.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Seven close friends drift apart into ruin until one of them gets a chance to rewind and repair what broke them.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He returns to the past determined to undo the choices that destroyed them, unsure whether any of it can still be fixed.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone wakes up as the villain of a dystopian story and resolves to play the part for the heroine's sake.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Staging threats to push her growth wins him unexpected public support and slowly turns her suspicion into an attachment that feels increasingly dangerous.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reincarnated into a smash-hit game world, he realizes he is only a disposable side character with a famously gruesome exit.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The production loved his death scene so much it has exclusive animation, so surviving every scripted demise becomes the whole mission.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Two strangers in their thirties still miss the partners they left and hatch a plan that is not exactly noble.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: They pretend to date each other, hoping jealousy will pull their old flames back, even if the scheme is foolish.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ordinary nobody gains a strange gift that pulls him into the lives written on any script he reads.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Performances born from those lived experiences make the industry mistake him for a once-in-a-generation talent overnight.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Waking up as the doomed older sister in a romance between men, she decides the safest plan is to keep her sibling far from every threat.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She especially steers him away from any admirer who might drag both of them into the tragic ending she remembers.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A first love who vanished without a word resurfaces years later on the same campus.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She is not the girl he remembers, and pretending not to care only makes the unfinished history harder to ignore.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a brutal murder in the family, a young martial artist infiltrates the enemy faction to find the killer.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His bloodlust impresses demonic masters and unlocks terrifying power that may help his revenge or destroy him first.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A modern vampire feeds on contact rather than blood and becomes obsessed with the unreachable neighbor next door.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He is a severe germaphobe, so every attempt to get close turns into a comedy of craving versus contamination fears.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A younger royal carries memories of another life while war and court intrigue close in on his family.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Assassins, mages, and uneasy allies gather around him as he tries to steer the kingdom away from the disaster he already lived.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Humiliated by a status-obsessed ex, a young woman learns she is actually the daughter of a powerful duke.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: New rank and power make revenge tempting, including a marriage that would deny her former love the title he wants.

entries.title: Why I Quit Being the Demon King

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A destined dark ruler is supposed to wait for a century-cycle duel that frees his kind from hell.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead he slips out decades early and tries to build an ordinary human life before the fated clash arrives.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Betrayed and killed by his own organization, a feared assassin wakes up wearing a badge.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He intends to use the new identity to hunt the guild of professionals that discarded him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A hunter receives an ability that keeps bringing him back no matter how many times he falls.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Immortality makes him infamous, and he keeps throwing himself into the worst fights so everyone else can live.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a monster-ravaged world, a powerless support worker watches the gifted fight while he hauls gear on the sidelines.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A sudden gift of special abilities lets him start claiming rewards for himself instead of only carrying other people's loot.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An orphaned, nearly blind teen endures bullying with only an imaginary companion for comfort.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After a beating, his scars and vision vanish overnight, and so does the little friend who kept him going.

entries.title: The Tyrant's Guardian Is an Evil Witch

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A powerful witch finds a child on her doorstep and recognizes the boy destined to kill her someday.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She tries to raise him with warmth instead of fear, hoping kindness can rewrite a future already pointed at her throat.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A loyal old porter with a lame leg never gets to fight until a fatal stand for a treasure rewrites his fate.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wakes in the body of a young master with a ruined reputation and finally has a chance to become the escort he always wanted to be.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An actress plagued by ghostly visions keeps dreaming of a girl murdered by the men in her own household.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Waking up as that doomed girl, she leans on restless spirits to win over the family that is supposed to kill her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A freshman who only wants to disappear into the crowd somehow lands among the school's most visible girls.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: On day one she is pulled into a tight squad with three standout beauties, and blending in becomes impossible.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Years after high school torment ruined everything, the victim finds a way to make the bully feel that pain firsthand.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Swapped into each other's bodies, the price of returning home becomes the bully's problem to solve.

entries.title: The Sweet Life of a Reincarnation Pro

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A prince who has already lived through a hundred lives just wants a quiet, profitable existence this time.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Magic, qi, and worse worlds taught him that staying low and stacking wealth is the safest way not to die young again.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Kicked out by his parents, a high schooler moves into a rough neighborhood plagued by nighttime attacks that leave bite marks.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wakes with strange marks of his own, and the pale classmate beside him looks far too familiar.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A boy who has never lost anything meets a girl who finally hands him a defeat.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Their rivalry turns into a high-stakes bet over who will claim the last word.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A modern reader wakes inside a fantasy heroine marked for an early death in a world of betrayal and monsters.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She flees a sacred destiny and a dangerous engagement, then teams up with a prince hunting noble conspiracies that may include her own house.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reborn as an overlooked royal, a girl resigns herself to a quiet life in the kitchen.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When a cursed conqueror sacks the kingdom, he spares her only so she will keep cooking under threat of death.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A loyal knight who lived for honor is executed by the liege she trusted most.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She wakes years before the blade falls and tries to abandon blind duty, only to find old habits and old enemies still closing in.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: On a campus full of polite smiles, a careful student keeps getting pulled into someone else's complicated orbit.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Seniority, jealousy, and half-hidden motives turn ordinary lectures and club halls into a maze of social traps.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After collapsing while fleeing war, a royal wakes up trapped in the body of a messenger bird.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She delivers intel for a skeptical commander hunting surviving royals, hoping each flight brings news of her family.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A proud heiress who rejected every suitor wakes up in a wedding dress on a ship she never boarded.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Forced into marriage with a decorated war hero and marooned for a honeymoon, the mismatched pair must cooperate if they want payback on whoever arranged it.

entries.title: Iris: The Lady and Her Smartphone

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Murdered by the husband and family she trusted, a noblewoman snaps back to the years before her wedding.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Armed with memories of another era, she seeks a powerful bachelor's help for revenge and gets a dating proposal she did not expect.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A frail noble daughter cast out for her mother's sins has only months left to live.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her father hires a mysterious count as protector while a deadly family feud closes in around them both.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A cold professional who never lets emotion interfere suddenly feels something after meeting a famous sweetheart in person.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The celebrity is equally smitten and wants help escaping a polished public image for something grittier and much more dangerous.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Two university friends end up on a televised romance competition that was never supposed to split them this way.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Each appears with the other's boyfriend, turning loyalty, fashion school rivalry, and prize money into a public mess.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A muscle-bound fighter who solves everything with blunt force loses everything to a demonic beast and gets sent back in time.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Armed with future knowledge, the younger version of himself trains and gathers allies before that catastrophe can repeat.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a deadly contest among royal heirs, a princess survives for years by pretending to have lost her mind.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When only a few siblings remain and she becomes a target, sudden divine gifts and a charming magician of unclear loyalty change the game.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A nameless prisoner raised in an underground cell knows only that his own father locked him away.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Prophecies of a world ending in blood and ash hang over him, and he still does not know whether any of it is true.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After decades as a brainwashed undead servant, a troublemaker son wakes back in the past with his family still alive.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He races to grow strong enough to stop the lich who once murdered them before that conquest of the world begins again.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a land where divine power sets your worth, a quiet herder hides a dangerous lineage and extraordinary strength.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A wandering knight sees through the disguise and offers a path to the capital that would end his safe anonymity forever.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reborn as the doomed antagonist of a romance novel, she scrambles to undo every mistake that led to a hideous end.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Engagement and good behavior should have saved her, yet the heroine's arrival makes her fiancé refuse to let go.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Unfairly suspended after a corruption scandal, an office worker needs any chance to reclaim his career.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Discovering a celebrated artist living under a false name hands him a delicate assignment that could restore everything.

entries.title: There's No Such Thing as a Bad Lady

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A hard-earned mage scraping by as a mercenary is assigned to tutor a temperamental noble girl who cannot cast at all.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She is one failure from convent exile, and their clashes may still be the only way to prove she is not a lost cause.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A powerful executive who lost his child to school violence adopts a dangerous girl freshly released from detention.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She was shaped into a human weapon by cruel experiments abroad, and he intends to aim that violence at the bullies who destroyed his family.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A sea-born girl trades her home for human legs after her own kind write her off.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: On land, a star athlete on the school team discovers her secret and offers to train her so she can prove them wrong.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Grief sends a young man storming into an empty music room chasing a melody he thought belonged to someone lost.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead he finds a new transfer student at the keys, and jealousy turns into a volatile bond neither of them planned.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An imperial daughter marked as a living omen is shunned by the family that should have protected her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Magic becomes her only path to being loved, until a destiny spell drops her beside a shackled boy carrying a grim past of his own.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A bitter noblewoman with one failed engagement wakes up from a night of mistakes beside the empire's ruler.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wants her heart, but she is reluctant to trust anyone after how the last match ended.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A shape-shifting fiancée flees abuse only to die at the hands of the partner she trusted.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She wakes years earlier with future knowledge, returns to her father's house, and finds her beastkin kin far kinder than she expected.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A would-be knight is cast out of her order for clumsiness, appetite, and broken gear.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her attempt to rescue an old traveler backfires, and he offers a cure for her hidden illness in exchange for a long journey.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Offline, he coasts through a dull life; online, he only wants the hardest, least glamorous path to the top.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The game keeps favoring him anyway, stacking absurd fortune on whatever low-status class he picks.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Having watched someone else lose at one-sided affection, a younger brother swears he will never be the one left wanting.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When he coaches a crush-struck senior to confess or quit, the advice collapses the moment his own feelings turn toward that same senior.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Trapped in a shifting maze of monsters and missions, a survivor keeps dying and waking up to try again.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: This run hands him endless passive abilities, but the layout keeps rewriting itself so past knowledge no longer helps.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A logout fails and dumps a ruthless player into a martial world that is no longer a game.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Schemes and malice already fill the streets, and his merciless habits start casting a long shadow over everyone who stands in his way.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: She wakes inside her favorite novel as the hated villainess doomed to die by the final page.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The plot she memorized veers off course, so dodging the leads' romance becomes harder than rewriting her own role.

entries.title: The Genius Swordsman of Mount Hua

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Cornered by a demonic ambush, a fighter receives a dying friend's last gift before the end.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: That gift drops him into a younger disciple's body, where he must rebuild fading techniques and honor a final wish.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After years of school bullying, a victim chooses the path of crime so he can strike back from the inside.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: In detention he finds some of his tormentors already locked up, while one unfinished score still waits outside.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A novelist builds a device to live inside her medieval fantasy, then cannot find the exit.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Disguised as a runaway slave, she meets the ambitious hero she wrote and must help topple a throne just to stay alive.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: When strange enemies fall from the sky and the world starts dying, ordinary teens are drafted to fight.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With too few soldiers left, high schoolers and college kids risk their lives so everyone else can survive.

entries.title: Peaceful Camping Life in Another World

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A celebrated cook who can no longer taste retreats to the countryside to escape the spotlight.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A portal to a strange land lets him chase a quiet outdoor routine, until the locals keep taking an inconvenient interest in him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A campus misunderstanding brands an athlete with a scandal that could cost him his scholarship.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The handsome troublemaker who started the rumor refuses to leave him alone, and hostility starts sliding into something messier.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A shunned half-noble wife trades her life to spare her husband from a power that is killing him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Reborn years younger and single, she sets out to win him all over again without repeating the same tragic ending.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Campus politics and tangled feelings still refuse to settle for a student caught between trust and doubt.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Old tensions with a calculating senior and a complicated circle of friends push toward a final reckoning.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A timid tenant opens his front door and finds a monster-filled labyrinth instead of the hallway.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Hiding fails, so he teams up with unlikely skeletal allies and a mysterious gift that unlocks rare magic.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A reader drops into her sibling's fantasy tale determined to keep the plot from turning into a tired cliché.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her role is only the main villain's older relative, and saving both the story and her own neck gets harder page by page.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Stuck as a harem novel's angelic love interest, a modern girl dumps the goofy hero to chase her own ending.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A blind date with a devilishly charming stranger goes well, until his odd behavior hints he is hiding something dangerous.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A matchless martial artist who ran out of worthy rivals is denied the next stage of power and falls hard.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wakes decades later in a younger clan heir's body, stripped of his old strength and burdened with a rare energy blockage.

entries.title: One Step Closer to the Demon King

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A ruler of the deep leaves the ocean to challenge a land-born tyrant whose infamy has reached the sea.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Gaining human legs costs every scrap of her power and leaves her in a helpless child's body.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A carefree noble learns doomsday is coming and that only one couple's unborn child can stop it.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She marries a notorious, feared lord to make that future happen, then discovers he refuses any intimacy at all.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The day a contract marriage ends, she watches her almost-ex die right in front of her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Fate yanks her a hundred days backward, and she uses the second chance to stop the accident before it can happen.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After another failed job hunt, a weary young woman vents to a kind stranger who vanishes and leaves a phone behind.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The only app on it connects her to a cryptic contact who claims to know who she is looking for, and a strange offer she has to accept.

entries.title: The Hopeless Desire of a Witch

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An orphan is adopted into nobility on one condition: track down the firestarter who destroyed his childhood village.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Trained among alchemists, he finally meets a gentle white-haired woman who does not match the monster of the rumors.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In an occupied land, a hardworking handmaiden who swims to survive finds a wounded rebel washed ashore.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After a botched attack steals her voice, she travels to the capital seeking revenge and gets pulled into a dangerous new world of resistance.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A chef whose senses of taste and smell have died sinks into despair until a hyper-real virtual world brings them back.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Cooking there means hunting monster ingredients himself, and he starts building a second career around both the kitchen and the fight.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: She wakes as the heroine of a favorite book whose ending she already knows will disappoint her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her new adoptive relatives will murder for control, and the male lead feels eerily familiar whenever she gets too close.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Nighttime noise from next door turns into an awkward daytime clash with a handsome student representative.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His reputation is shaky and both of them are hiding feelings, until closeness makes her wonder what he is keeping secret too.

entries.title: I Will Become the Villain's Poison Taster

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An office worker dies in an accident and wakes as a condemned noblewoman meant to be finished off in her cell.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Assassins keep failing because every toxin she swallows tastes oddly pleasant, and she starts using that quirk to stay alive.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a city of televised hunter fights, a cameraman for a mediocre crew suddenly ends up in front of the lens.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Nonhuman viewers start watching too, and more attention means more power as the creatures keep coming.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Humanity fails to stop a massive asteroid, and ordinary life ends in fire.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: An average office worker is yanked backward in time with one slim chance to keep the catastrophe from ever happening.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A devoted fan dies mid-reread and wakes inside her favorite fantasy book, in the room of the overlooked supporting cast she adored.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He can hear her thoughts whenever she focuses on him, and she has to stop his doomed fate before it arrives.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Old school rivals reunite years later when their siblings marry, only for tragedy to shatter the new family.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: They wake back in high school with a diary and a second chance to rewrite their siblings' destinies before fate repeats.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a mission goes wrong, a doubtful operative is sent undercover to a famous magic academy.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His real job is protecting an important family's son who is having a miserable time at school.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A commoner who saved a duke's heir rises to command the emperor's knights and becomes a war hero.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: One unexpected night leaves her expecting, and fear of scandal drives her to hide the child from the noble father.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A high schooler's death at a witch's hands turns out to be the start of something worse and stranger.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Now undead and unable to stay dead, he is pulled into a parallel realm where magic rules and survival means adapting fast.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Born with rare martial power, a student enrolls in a special academy meant to train fighters for justice.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He is really hunting the truth behind a missing parent and a faction that wants his family's secret techniques, while a legendary masked vigilante resurfaces.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A viscount's overlooked second son is squeezed out of his own home by a scheming stepmother and half-brother.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Powers he honed in an online game somehow work in the real world, and he starts using them to fight for his inheritance.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a kill-or-be-killed world, an orphan from the fringe can see ambient power as vivid color while feeling almost nothing.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A life-shattering event cracks that numbness, and the path ahead starts filling with emotion he never expected to carry.

entries.title: My Sister Picked Up The Male Lead

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Living comfortably inside a novel she once read, a girl thinks she already knows how every page will go.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A strange amnesiac boy arrives as an unwanted birthday present, and meeting him puts her foretold death back on the table.

entries.title: Secretly More Powerful than the Hero

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a fatal accident, a reincarnation bargain lets him live as a weakling who is actually absurdly strong.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The catch is brutal: if anyone ever learns what he can really do, his heart will explode.

entries.title: They Say I Was Born a King's Daughter

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Murdered just as she found real love, a young woman wakes fully aware inside a newborn princess's life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Appalled by how even royal women are treated, she sets out to challenge the kingdom's rigid patriarchy from the cradle up.

entries.title: Daisy: How to Become the Duke's Fiancée

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Betrayed by the man she loved, a timid girl dies and returns determined not to repeat her mistakes.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A terrifying aristocrat offers to clear her father's gambling debt through a short contract marriage that promises money and a clean divorce.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A film-club president steps into the rain for quiet and ends up catching a stranger dancing and singing in the downpour.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When that same girl joins the club, a fleeting moment starts turning into something that feels like the romances she only watched on screen.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A peasant girl whose looks once spared her worse fates is sold off to serve in a noble household.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her real post is tending a young lord hidden away from the public, and she must survive his tyranny while staying unseen.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A sudden accident flings a young woman a decade into her own past, back to high school.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The second chance is really about keeping the person she has always loved from dying this time around.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A fallen heiress reduced to chores and nagging in-laws discovers her husband loves someone else under her own roof.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Death sends her back a year, and she uses the rewind to seize the wealth and status she once surrendered.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Buried in debt after losing her parents, a young woman accepts a dangerous noble's offer of marriage as her only way out.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She plans to quietly pocket funds and vanish, until her new father-in-law's unexpected kindness makes her wonder if he already knows.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A favored royal with a clear path to the throne starts seeing flashes of a future that make her distrust everyone close to her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her once-trusted mother, a shunned half-royal sibling, and a stranger all seem tangled in that vision, and the ending may not be the crowning she expected.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After being sacrificed by her own kin and dying for a loyalty that was never returned, a woman opens her eyes years earlier.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: This time she considers standing beside the tyrant she once refused, recognizing they were shaped by the same kind of betrayal.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A glamorous influencer seems to have the perfect online life, until someone starts watching her posts a little too closely.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Behind the sponsorships and endless likes, an obsessed stranger is turning her public image into a hunting ground.

entries.title: The Reason She Lives as a Villainess

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a fatal accident, a woman wakes inside a romantic fantasy as a hated supporting role with a brutal checklist ahead.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She must outmaneuver an abusive father's treason plot, slip free of a crown engagement, and stay clear of a duke who seems to know too much, all while trying not to die again.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A king married into a powerful house grows cold and suspicious as his father-in-law circles the throne.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His queen carries a curse that locks every secret inside her, including the truth of who she once was to him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A girl born among healers but lacking their gift is sent as a sacrifice to an emperor cursed with endless bloodlust.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: At court she is expected to die like the others before her, yet the two of them may be the only ones who can break each other's doomed loops.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A hardened mercenary mage rewinds her life to reclaim lost years and buried power before tragedy can repeat.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: In the past she must outlast a cruel stepmother and an unwanted engagement while seeking the swordsman who once mattered most to her.

entries.title: The Newlywed Diary of a Witch and a Dragon

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A rising mage risks her reputation after one night with a new hire who suddenly asks her to marry him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She agrees under pressure, unaware that her charming partner is hiding a nature that could upend both their careers and their hearts.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After years of abuse, a young mage escapes her father's house and begins rewriting a story she somehow already knows.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She wants to heal a land-wide contamination and spare the destined champion a tragic end, even as her own death date keeps closing in.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The greatest mage of his age dies in a demon war and wakes decades later in a weaker, disgraced body.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His old order lies in ruins under rival factions, his magic is sealed, and former allies now want him gone for good.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young man living alone on part-time wages suddenly becomes responsible for a little girl with nowhere else to go.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Rather than send her to an orphanage after a relative's death, he takes her in and learns parenting on the fly in a tiny apartment.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A gamer whose career was ruined by a rival returns online with a carefully built fake persona and a long grudge.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The plan is to make his enemy fall hard, then expose everything publicly, until the target starts caring a little too sincerely.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Students gather in a strange school where good deeds and karma can buy a second shot at life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The goal is not graduation but earning enough merit to reincarnate as the version of yourself you always wanted.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A high-flying lawyer fighting corruption is murdered by the very powers he challenged.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Sent back in time with a strange new authority from beyond the grave, he sets out to rewrite both his fate and his country's.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A new adult starting university finds her first love living next door and sitting in her classes again.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Five years after dumping him, she has to figure out dating without letting gossip and old feelings run the show.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Betrayed by someone she trusted, a woman faces the blade, then wakes years earlier with the chance to stop it.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: This time she refuses to be blindsided and moves early against the people who once changed overnight into her enemies.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An elite agent sheds his identity and steps into the life of his twin, a crime syndicate boss.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Loyalties blur in the underworld as he hunts vengeance while wearing a brother's face that was never meant to be his cover.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A century after tiny predators evolved into the planet's apex hunters, only a few thousand humans remain.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: An elite squad races for buried research that might tip the war, while the swarm only grows smarter and hungrier.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A dull office transfer turns sweet when a new manager becomes quietly obsessed with an older colleague's competence and charm.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The closer he gets, the more cracks show in her independent front, and workplace romance proves messier than the crush.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A skeptical player is pulled into the palace romance game she used to mock, stuck in the role everyone hates.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Escape requires crowning herself empress while dodging a cruel king, scheming rivals, and other players after the same ending.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A junior knight is pulled from a cliff after an ambush, alive but missing her memories.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She now acts childlike, eats endlessly, and hits with unnatural strength, and her relieved brother slowly realizes something is off.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Tired of constant attention from guys, a popular young woman decides a fake boyfriend might finally buy her peace.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The handsome stranger she picks turns out to be a girl herself, and their pretend romance gets complicated fast.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A student grinding a VR game for tuition is ready to quit when a sudden break flips his fortunes.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Powerful gear and an elusive warrior faction pull him deeper into the game's secrets before that streak can run dry.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After waking from a childhood coma with someone else's life also in her head, a soft-spoken girl tries to rebuild ordinary days.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A wrong turn at the palace puts her face to face with a feared crown prince whose temper is as sharp as his reputation.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A loyal knight gives everything to the ruler she loves, only to be betrayed and killed for a curse that warped her face.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Returned years earlier, she trains to break the family affliction and grow strong enough to slip free of his reach.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A hot-blooded prosecutor is murdered while hunting a man who effectively owns the country.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A deal with death sends him back to high school age, where he starts building power early enough to take the tyrant down.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A former athlete rebuilds her life after a donated heart saves her from a terminal illness.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Meeting a lonely classmate makes her pulse race for reasons she cannot explain, until a dream introduces the heart's former owner.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A legendary talking blade that forged heroes across ages ends up stuck with a greedy, useless royal heir.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When the prince dies on its edge, the weapon wakes in his body and must decide whether the disgrace is a prison or a path to becoming a hero himself.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ordinary high schooler goes to bed with normal teen problems and wakes up bound to a terrifyingly devoted demon spouse.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He is absurdly powerful, weirdly domestic, and far too eager to help, turning her quiet routine into supernatural chaos.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A college loner's life turns strange when a new neighbor's cursed trinket latches onto him and will not come off.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Ghosts start flocking to him everywhere, so he ends up helping the neighbor ferry restless spirits onward until they can break the bind.

entries.title: The Perfect Plan for a Fairy-Tale Ending

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reborn as the cruel sibling in a famous fairy tale, a girl refuses to play the villain who ruins an abused sister's life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead of waiting for a prince, she tries to deliver her sister to safety herself so both of them can escape the house of torment.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Childhood friends drift into messy high school feelings when one of them finally confesses.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A third person resents how close they are, and a noisy love triangle forms around people who thought they knew each other.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A top-ranked player who finds real life dull dies on the way home and wakes inside a body that should not be his.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He is now the demon king's son, forced to trade keyboard mastery for a throne-side life he never asked for.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A former high-ranker jumps into a new VR world planning to climb without doing all the dirty work himself.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The underlings he recruits are terrifyingly effective, and also so bloodthirsty he starts wondering who is really in charge.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A year after high school drama, two young adults try to balance university, work, and a fragile new romance.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Their days revolve around a shared cafe and art studio, where ordinary schedules still leave room for heartbreak and hope.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ordinary high schooler shares an easy, unromantic friendship with a clumsy classmate.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: One accidental discovery of that friend's deepest secret makes his heart race, and he cannot tell if it is fear or something else.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After saving another world, a champion comes home with one humble goal: feed people dishes from the land he left behind.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The ingredients are mostly monster parts, the government takes notice, and otherworldly beasts start following him to Earth.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young man born into a crime family wants nothing more than a quiet, ordinary life away from that name.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After finally cutting ties, he is kidnapped and lands under the protection of someone even further from normal than the world he fled.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: New Year's Eve shopping turns into a bloodbath when monsters suddenly appear in a crowded store.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A man with hard-earned combat skills from his old job fights to protect survivors as the creatures keep coming stronger, and humans prove just as dangerous.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An unremarkable student cannot believe the prettiest girl in school suddenly wants to stay under his roof.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: What feels like a dream come true slowly reveals the messier reasons she needs a place to belong.

entries.title: Crawling My Way to the Top!

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A successful man dies and wakes as an infant in a loving but desperately poor household.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Armed with an adult mind and tycoon instincts, he sets out to make his new family rich without waiting to grow up first.

entries.title: Being Loved for the First Time

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After nearly a hundred lives spent dying to save the world, a girl is born again expecting the same fear and abuse.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead her new family showers her with genuine warmth, and she cannot decide whether to trust it or wait for the betrayal.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Humans and demons live in separate realms with almost no safe way to cross between them.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A rare passage becomes mankind's last hope for travel and survival when the boundary between worlds starts to matter most.

entries.title: There Are No Bad Warriors in This World

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A world champion fighter dies in an accident and agrees to keep battling in the afterlife as a hero.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A celestial mix-up drops him among demons instead, where he climbs through charm and fists while learning good and evil are not clean sides.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A former world-class competitor loses interest in gaming when the title he dominated finally shuts down.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A school club and a new team-based sequel that feels eerily familiar pull him back into climbing the ranks with teammates for the first time.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Cast out of a prestigious martial family for his birth, a young man scrapes by in the shadows until kin schemes end his life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Sent back with the power to read a weapon's memories, he trains through inheritance wars, monster-haunted wilds, and clan blood feuds to survive.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Bounty hunters scrape by in a distant future where martial arts still decide who rules the stars.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A job on a ruined homeworld delivers something older and deadlier than the payday they expected: a living relic of the old arts.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A career criminal who climbed a ruthless organization finds his ending as empty as the rest of his life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Given another shot, he tries undoing old habits one small good deed at a time, with no idea how to be decent.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young northern lord steeped in grief wanders after losing the person he loved most.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A legendary flower hints she returned somehow, and his search pulls him across the boundary into a strange new world.

entries.title: The Fake Lady and Her Rabbit Duke
