storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Two glittering figures of high society share more than reputation: each is hiding a dangerous secret.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She finds him cursed into a tiny animal form, and their carefully built cover stories start unraveling together.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A kind woman rescues a child from a dark auction, unaware of the violent noble hiding in that small body.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Years of care bind them, then tragedy and court intrigue tear them apart until he returns as the man he truly is.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Even endless resets and unmatched power cannot stop the world from ending.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The catastrophe traces back to four playful hatchlings, so he abandons domination and tries to raise them safely instead.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: When her brother vanishes and their father dies, a celebrated young woman must hold the family name together alone.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She accepts a political marriage to protect their standing, hoping duty might still leave room for something real.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A thoroughly average young man has little going for him except a habit of burying himself in books.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A strange blank volume starts trading passages for power, turning everything he finishes into real abilities.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A confident campus star and a quiet loner collide over the country's hottest online game.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Friendships, rivalries, and status all get rewritten when the supposed beginner keeps winning matches no one expected.

entries.title: I Dream of Health, Wealth, and a Long Life

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A peasant who died too young wakes inside a novel as a noble side character doomed to suffer.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She recruits unlikely allies while dodging a cruel stepmother, determined that this life will end differently.

entries.title: I've been Proposed to by a Villain

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Dropped into a novel, she knows exactly which ruthless noble is supposed to end her life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After she witnesses his crime anyway, he offers marriage instead of a blade, and she has no idea why.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A neglected bride loses her child and her husband's warmth, written off as cursed and disposable.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A contract with a playful water spirit gives her power and spine, just as the man who discarded her starts looking back.

entries.title: My Husband Who Hates Me Has Lost His Memories

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A political bride endures a loveless household while quietly waiting for the split she expects.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: An accident wipes his hostility clean, and sudden tenderness leaves her unsure whether to trust the change.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A mountain beast lord's quiet life ends when a white-haired girl arrives claiming she is his bride.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her bloodline terrifies every spirit around them, yet he keeps her close once he sees she has nowhere else to go.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A betrayed mage wakes as a neglected infant in a rival house that barely remembers she exists.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A childish comfort object somehow sharpens her mind, letting her scheme revenge from the cradle.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: To keep her family from ruin, an older sister hunts for a marriage alliance she never wanted for herself.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When the intended bride runs off, she takes the arrogant duke's deal herself, staking honor for survival.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A girl's first crush ends when he admits he likes someone else.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wrongly steers her toward his intimidating best friend, and that awkward setup becomes a closer problem than heartbreak.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A lifelong underachiever suddenly summons a creature far too strong for his station.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The catch is he cannot send it away, so the attention-magnet follows him while he schemes a way to the top.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Talking to a girl who always looks angry feels impossible for a shy boy.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Everything he blurts out somehow hits her hardest, and a clumsy first love grows between them.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A blind princess who sees spirits is bound in an unwanted marriage to a general whose presence drives them back.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She needs his purifying aura, he needs her sacred blood, and a deadly ghost with a hollow heart circles them both.

entries.title: The Flower Dances and the Wind Sings

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: On her deathbed, a mother regrets every cold year she spent distant from her child.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Sent years backward, she tries to repair the marriage and motherhood she ruined, only to find politics complicating the redo.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Hidden among ordinary people live animals who never finished becoming human.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A normal student stumbles onto their secret and gets pulled into comedy, exorcism, and a messy bid to finish that transformation.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Knights keep dying trying to free a princess cursed into endless sleep by a dark lord.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A nameless challenger finally arrives to end the curse, unaware that fate has other plans for him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A demonic cultivator's breakthrough is shattered by a voice, and he wakes to find his world already conquered.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Centuries later he returns to a realm where magic and martial arts share the same battlefields, and his old order is gone.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Giant insects threaten humanity, and gifted defenders are the only line that holds.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After tragedy, an ordinary viewer is dragged into the program that made those heroes, forced to face lost years and a violent reaction to his own wounds.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A boy inherits a fading death-magic house after enemies force him to end his own father's life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: To rebuild what remains, he bargains with the ancient demon that first powered his bloodline.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An overworked designer dies and wakes in a renaissance court ruled by a conqueror who hates her own wardrobe.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Disguised as a man, she climbs into the palace atelier to fix outdated clothes, risking exposure when the queen's brother notices.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reborn as an obsessive villainess, she plans to leave her marriage before the story's bloody ending finds her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her husband's terror of touch derails the exit plan, and helping him heal pulls them closer instead.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A moody high schooler hides world-ending psychic power and a desire to burn everything down.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Every lethal use of his gift flings him backward in time, so he keeps hunting whoever traps him in the loop.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After months on the run, an undead outcast is offered up so a holy knight can claim glory.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Sent back before that bitter end, he swears this life will not finish the same way, whatever it costs.

entries.title: The World is Money and Power

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A transfer student walks into a high school run by heirs who treat classmates like chips on a table.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Gambling and hierarchy rule the halls, and he sets out to break the richest family's grip on campus order.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: By day she is a mistreated office secretary; by night she writes under a pen name no one at work can know.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her rude but sharp boss starts hunting for the book's creator, and keeping that secret suddenly gets personal.

entries.title: Saving the Villain from the Heroine

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A handmaid recognizes her master from a novel she once read, and uses that knowledge to stop an assassination.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Framed for the crime and shrunk into a child's body by poison, she is packed off toward a house of killers.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An unknown performer cleans houses between auditions and wonders if her career already ended.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A gallery full of her younger face turns her into a photographer's reluctant subject, and a second shot at the spotlight.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A legend of a forgotten online world jumps into its hotter sequel expecting an easy climb back to the top.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His hidden class locks him into a weak support role, so the only path upward is enabling everyone else.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a district where tiny offenses mean death, a girl only wants to keep her head down and escape.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After she snaps, she becomes a wanted rebel with growing power, dragged into open war against the bureau that owns justice.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A modern reader wakes as the cold emperor's neglected wife and immediately starts planning her exit.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Every attempt to push him away only makes the tyrant more curious, twisting escape into unwanted closeness.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Ten years into an apocalypse, a dying survivor begs for one more chance.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wakes a decade earlier in a non-human body and decides survival alone is not enough: this time he wants to live large.

entries.title: Trash Belongs in the Trash Can!

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A charming hustler lives off wealthy women until the next mark makes him fall for real.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Blinded by affection, he misses how dangerous she is, and their romance becomes a trap neither meant to leave cleanly.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A reader wakes in the body of a story's heroine, haunted by the loyal attendant doomed to die for her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She tries to rewrite his ending, but the original heroine and a scheming duke return to complicate every careful change.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A modern everyman wakes as a grand prince in a historical dynasty on the brink of terror.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His older brother is set to become an infamous tyrant, so he starts steering court politics before history repeats.

entries.title: The Stars Are on My Side

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After civilization falls, survivors cling to towering refuges where climbing higher means power and status.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A low-ranked grunt gains a circuit that unlocks memories from past lives as legendary climbers, and those echoes refuse to stay quiet.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The sole survivor of a massacred martial clan turns ruthless to stay alive in a hostile world.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Dying at the peak of that bloody path, he wakes decades earlier with his family still intact and a chance to choose differently.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A quiet high schooler hides a soft side that does not match the face he shows in class.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After a classmate catches him on a disastrous date, the secret he wanted kept ordinary suddenly has a witness.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Born to a hated woman, a girl spends her life carrying a stigma she never earned.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After watching her mother die in disgrace, she fights to carve out her own name before the same ending finds her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A loyal friend is used and discarded by the dazzling socialite she helped crown.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A magical second chance from a dragon lets her return clear-eyed, ready to stop the climb she once cheered for.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a land split between cursed mages and blessed knights, a girl hides which side she was born on.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Training to join the holy order, she accidentally summons the continent's greatest enemy, and his puzzling admission derails everything.

entries.title: The Holy Emperor's Grandson is a Necromancer

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A gamer dies mid-session and wakes as the troublemaking grandson of a sacred throne.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His death magic mixes with royal blood in ways that heal, strengthen, and refuse to stay simple, while he mostly just wants a nap.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A feared captain and rare swordmaster is married off in secret to a northern grand duke.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He treats her like fragile porcelain while she plots a quiet exit, terrified of revealing the battlefield reputation that made suitors vanish.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A worn-down worker hits rock bottom and is stopped mid-despair by a supernatural bargain that forces her to keep living under a strange condition.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She wakes transformed into a household pet and winds up in her aloof boss's care, chasing the affection she never got while human.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Years after a childhood act of mercy, a young woman is traded away to secure her family's survival when invaders arrive.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She must journey to an arid foreign court bound to its feared ruler, though the conqueror once owed his life to her in a form she barely remembers.

entries.title: The Evil Princess Dreams of a Gingerbread House

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reborn as a storybook royal with a grim fate ahead, a little girl wants nothing more than a quiet life of sweets and baking.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She realizes she is the doomed antagonist of the tale, and leans on childish charm plus a powerful spirit ally to rewrite how her story ends.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A popular bully and his quiet classmate keep circling each other in a pattern that looks like cruelty from the outside.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Each spins lies to trap the other, and the messy obsession between them might tip into something that feels like romance.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After an unfair death, a woman wakes as a glamorous noble with a strange gift from a vanity-loving deity.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She can sketch people into existence, and she puts that talent to work flooding the world with handsome men for everyone's benefit.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A former troublemaker gets a divine ultimatum: keep doing good, or face damnation.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A perky guardian angel heals his limp and watches him closely, while a petty god decides whether empty helpfulness is enough.

entries.title: The Back Alley Mage's Second Life

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A loyal servant of a powerful magic house is used up, betrayed, and killed, then wakes young again with hard-won foresight.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Back among the streets of his early years, he refuses to serve anyone this time and aims to master power for himself.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Dropped into a royal story she once followed beat for beat, a woman loses nearly everyone she loved before getting another run at the beginning.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: This time she and a princess ally rewrite choices to stop a violent uprising, knowing every change may uncover new traitors.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A fan of a modern fantasy setting gets pulled into that world as a shiny new hire at a dream company.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Benefits, salary, and kind bosses stack up fast using her story knowledge, yet she would trade it all just to clock out permanently and go home.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ordinary office worker drops into a scandalous palace romance novel as household staff tangled in royal affairs.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After the crown prince's previous caregiver is murdered, she is forced into that dangerous post and must navigate cutthroat court drama while raising a child.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A shy student finally confesses his crush, only to find the wrong person standing behind him when he turns around.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The school's most popular girl thinks the confession was for her and agrees to date him, leaving him scrambling to untangle the mix-up.

entries.title: The Returned C-Rank Tank Won't Die!

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Abandoned by her party in a dungeon, a timid low-rank hunter finds an artifact that refuses to let her body stay broken.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Years of endless killing and healing leave her colder and haunted, hunting answers and payback while the relic's own will begins to show.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Betrayed by his guild and crushed by a top rival, a competitive player dies in an accident and wakes years earlier at the game's start.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Armed with future knowledge, he climbs the rankings while refusing to rebuild the guild life that got him killed.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Between odd jobs and an empty dating life, a woman takes a cleaning gig and meets a shut-in whose apartment is a disaster.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A missing collectible during her shift ropes her into unpaid chores as payback, and two people who only crush on screens start noticing each other in person.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a fearful town, a bullied girl is whispered about as a witch's child while strange deaths begin to mount.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Two skeptical friends stand by her at first, but suspicion closes in on all three as magic and rumor turn lethal.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After throwing herself into the sea, a young woman wakes in a lazy monster's underground lair instead of finding an end.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She settles into a cozy, food-filled partnership with adorable creatures, trading cooking for a surprisingly symbiotic life.

entries.title: I Became the Mother of the Evil Male Lead

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reborn into a dark romance novel, a woman finds herself raising the boy destined to become its obsessive, deadly center.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Neglect shaped his future cruelty, so she must rebuild warmth at home and mend things with a cold estranged husband before that path locks in.

entries.title: Regression of the Yong Clan Heir

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A broken martial heir is flung back in time, still carrying a monstrous darkness that whispers for control.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: While fighting the shadow in his mind, he digs for a dormant power that might save his faded school or doom it.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After dying young life after life, a soul bargains for a wealthy, strong body with fewer messy attachments.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She lands as a duke's daughter with most of what she asked for, and her only real goal is living past the birthday that always ends her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A late-blooming hunter spends decades mastering a strange gift that lets him claim power from magical items, then gets a trip back to his awakening day.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: This time he wastes none of those years, rapidly stacking stolen strengths and climbing ranks toward the hero role he always wanted.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Born under the worst curse in a wandering messenger bloodline, a low-ranked courier scrapes for a way to break free.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: While he gathers coin across the continent, his twin digs into a vast conspiracy that may decide both their fates.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A master of spirits who never fit among people dies and wakes as a quiet, bullied young prince.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With his elemental companions still beside him, he enters an elite school to rebuild that body's reputation while old dangers stalk his new life.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Hopeless at romance and driving every suitor away, a woman seeks professional help navigating relationships.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The specialist she hires becomes the first person she starts catching real feelings for, which complicates the lessons.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a vision of how tormenting a doomed boy will wreck her future, a girl tries to stay far from him and fails.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Protecting him until a powerful noble claims him as a ward ends with an unexpected offer to join that household as his betrothed.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A high schooler who learned young that liking boys was "weird" finally decides he cannot keep burying those feelings.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Online advice and a supportive queer classmate help him face a crush on a kind peer without vanishing into denial again.

entries.title: The Villainess Becomes the Leading Lady

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reborn as a doomed wicked noble in a fantasy novel, a woman thinks she left her high-school tormentor behind.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The story's heroine, her estranged sister, wears a familiar bully's face, so she seeks a dangerous royal ally for both survival and payback.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: On a school trip to the capital, students watch a mysterious infection turn people into dripping, contagious horrors.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A quiet crush becomes the least of one boy's worries as classmates race to escape before the city is fully swallowed.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ordinary kid with a loser's reputation at school suddenly catches fire for a sport after one forced watch of a match.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He throws himself into soccer despite the mockery, trying to prove a "king of losers" can become someone the pitch respects.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: When gates open and monsters pour in, monks intervene in human life and ordinary people scramble for any edge.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: One fighter's odd medications start behaving like battle stimulants, slowing the world and sharpening every reflex mid-fight.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A sentient spellbook sits unused on an academy shelf for centuries, waiting for someone worthy to open it.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After one apprentice dies trying, a mysterious girl binds herself as its new contractor and finally gives the lonely volume a purpose.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An illegitimate saint is betrayed by the family and fiancé who sold her to a demon, then spends centuries in torment.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A bargain sends her back in a powerful noble child's body, hell-bent on revenge while faces from her old life threaten to stop her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A popular social media star with almost no dating experience finally lands a night out with someone she has quietly admired.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A mortifying karaoke mishap ends the romance, until the part-timer who witnessed it shows up as a new classmate.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A local lowlife noble suddenly starts acting like the upright knight everyone wished he would be.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The empire's fallen champion is possessing him, teaming with unlikely allies (including a former enemy) to punish the friends who betrayed him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a rough house of work, one woman takes in another who has nowhere else to fall.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Friendship is offered freely, but the newcomer seems more interested in extracting secrets than settling in.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After countless rebirths, an infant finally lands in a life where chasing the stage feels possible again.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Past-life magic helps a baby charm playmates and go viral with a feeding video, drawing an entertainment company before the act can keep up.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A victorious knight commander returns home only to lose her fiancé to a fallen enemy princess, then wakes in a modern shy student's body.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Classmates who look exactly like the betrayers help her hunt a way back, blurring which world is the story and which is real.

entries.title: Beloved by the Male Lead's Nephew

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reborn as a doomed stalker villainess, a woman flees the capital to avoid the powerful man she was scripted to obsess over.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Returning a year later, she rescues a street child who turns out to be that man's long-lost relative, making a quiet handoff almost impossible.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A burned-out veterinary intern wakes inside a shunned schoolkid's body in a world that only half matches the novel he once read.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Status screens, feisty dragon partners, and classmates destined as enemies force him to prove his skills can last until graduation.

entries.title: The Return of Elena the Knight

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After her royalist house is wiped out and she fails a final stand for revenge, a sole survivor is thrown back to the year before the massacre.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She races to shield the crown prince early, offering both her sword and a betrothal so their shared enemies never get a second chance.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A prodigy mage collapses when a condition stops him from releasing the mana he can still sense and shape.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Bullied after his fall from grace, he clings to a sudden interface message that hints at an impossible new way to fight.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A war hero is rewarded with marriage to a princess everyone treats as broken and mindless.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Between the drooling and screams, he catches flashes of sharp awareness and starts wondering how much of the madness is performance.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A noblewoman stuck in a loveless engagement decides charm and leverage can secure a better exit than heartbreak ever could.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She coaches a feared battlefield butcher through ordinary courage and aims her fortune at toppling one of the empire's most powerful houses.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A man makes a living as a lookalike who handles celebrities' ordinary social lives while they fight elsewhere.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When the strongest champion hires him for a huge payout, the meetup reveals something far stranger than a simple stand-in job.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: At a serene religious school, one student endures daily bullying until a beautiful classmate steps in.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Gratitude comes easy, but the savior's smile may hide motives that are anything but pure.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Faced with a forced marriage into captivity, a girl wakes eight years earlier and still cannot stop the first tragedy.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Refusing to surrender, she sets out to find the parent who might unlock her freedom, unsure whether that reunion means safety or ruin.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a miserable marriage ends on false grounds, a noblewoman finally walks free and builds a sweet new livelihood from family recipes.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Rave reviews draw sabotage from her ex and his lover, turning a quiet shop into a battlefield over who gets to taste success.

entries.title: A Ranker's Guide to the Good Life

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a world of hunters and monsters, one awaken-ee seems content to sit out the fame chase and enjoy a quiet, easy routine.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She is secretly the strongest of them all, until a time-traveling stranger warns that humanity's future depends on her finally stepping forward.

entries.title: Lord Baby Runs a Romance Fantasy With Cash

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A devoted genre reader reincarnates into a wretched, zero-rated story as an abandoned noble infant.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Thieving relatives and a vile father leave her scraping to survive until a quest interface activates, offering a powered ticket out of misery.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Gigantic insects try to flip the food chain and claim humanity as prey in a citywide invasion.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A middle manager has one goal through the chaos: get his family out alive before the swarm finishes rewriting who eats whom.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A polished eldest child spends her life performing perfection for a demanding parent, until a sibling's drowning plants terrible doubt.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Convinced the household's ideal is a cage built on violence, she plots an escape while that same parent tries to force the "perfect" life she never had onto her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An adult returns to settle unfinished business from a friendship he abandoned when everything went wrong.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: To dig up the truth, he embeds himself beside a volatile underworld figure and wonders if the man he serves is the boy he once swore to protect.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone wakes up as a side character in a fantasy romance and plans to stay invisible.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Quiet survival gets harder when royalty unexpectedly takes an interest, dragging him into court drama he never wanted.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A traveler fleeing her old life ends up stranded in a realm overrun by undead creatures.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her rescue comes from a sworn holy warrior whose vows clash with the chemistry she keeps stirring to stay alive.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a crash, she wakes in a royal body that has been twisted into something people fear on sight.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Suddenly huge, furred, and terrifying to her own court, she has to figure out how to live as a cursed princess nobody wants near them.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A soldier who died fighting invaders from beyond Earth wakes up as a teenage noble in a world of magic.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Navigating monsters and court politics is hard enough, and the enemies he thought he left behind may already be closer than they look.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After lifetimes of abuse by the friend she trusted most, she finally gets another chance at life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A powerful noble brings her into his household under a new identity, and she starts using that cover to turn the tables.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A model student famous for kindness quietly engineers every good deed for the sake of his image.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When a classmate back from illness overhears the truth, blackmail turns into a tense push and pull between two people who cannot stay cleanly apart.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A war-hardened martial disciple finally comes home expecting peace after years of bloody conflict.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He finds his countryside school crushed by thugs, and the quiet life he wanted turns into another fight to protect what is left of his master and juniors.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A quiet-looking teen secretly livestreams himself punishing school bullies across the country.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With hired muscle at his back, he tries to wipe out every delinquent he can find, even as the targets start adapting and pushing back harder.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A book-obsessed student joins a game just so nobody will interrupt his pages.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Closing each volume starts raising his wisdom like a level-up, turning quiet reading into a strange new kind of growth.

entries.title: The Hero, the Demon, and the Villain

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A would-be savior infiltrates enemy territory hunting rare sword techniques that could save her family.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: There she crosses paths with a notorious foe who hides a lost skill, and the line between ally and enemy starts to blur.

entries.title: The Reborn Prodigy of the Ducal Family

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A legendary fighter who was used as a disposable weapon for an empire dies and wakes as a noble heir.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With a second life in a powerful house, he starts using brilliance and old grudges to tear down the regime that once bound him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A teen remade himself into the center of attention and treats status like a full-time job.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: An equally self-obsessed rival crashes into his orbit, wrongly convinced the feeling between them is a crush, and the contest turns personal.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman glimpses someone's future every time their lips meet, and she never sees herself in those visions.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: One accidental peck with her harsh boss shows a shockingly intimate destiny, just as her old first love joins the same workplace.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A girl raised among criminals believes she is doomed to be the villain in someone else's story.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After comforting a kidnapped noble child, she is taken into the same household, where unexpected warmth challenges the guilty role she assigned herself.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A broke job-seeker with nothing in the bank keeps failing to land steady work.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Even with a fierce reputation from punishing physical odd jobs, she still has to claw her way out of chronic unemployment one awkward interview at a time.

entries.title: My BFF is a Tyrant in Training

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman reborn into a novel dies on schedule, then wakes as the same child again with the plot still unfinished.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: To keep history from collapsing, she has to steer her childhood friend into becoming the cruel ruler the story demanded.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An overlooked imperial daughter is finally useful when her empire needs a living offering to call down an ancient power.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: At the moment of the ritual, something unexpected claims her instead, and survival suddenly depends on a stranger who appears in the god's place.

entries.title: Writing My Male Lead's Happily Ever After

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The author of a tragic romance wakes up as the villainess her own plot is destined to destroy.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Faced with the broken man she wrote into obsession and madness, she tries to teach him gentler love before quietly exiting when the heroine arrives.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A grieving young artist moves into an empty seaside house hoping to finally focus on drawing.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His muse turns out to be a forgotten water being with no past, and helping her remember becomes tangled with his own recovery.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After years living in someone else's body, she snaps back to her original life and finds it ruined.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: First on the list is ditching a cold aristocratic marriage, then settling scores with everyone who thrived while she was gone.

entries.title: I Got Pregnant with the Tyrant's Child

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A royal guard lets loose at a masked festival and wakes beside the empire's most feared ruler.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She tries to hide what happened while still protecting him, until sickness and cravings make the secret nearly impossible to keep.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A student cannot shake a bloody nighttime encounter that looks like a monster out of a nightmare.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The same figure shows up at school clingy and oddly domestic, more into cuddles and cooked meat than classic horror, and will not leave him alone.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Following odd advice, a boy trains himself to see every girl as something lifeless and ignorable.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: One classmate breaks the trick completely, and after years of numbness his brain finally notices a real face again.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After losing both home and work at once, she takes a live-in caretaker job she cannot afford to refuse.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The house is full of odd people, and her first clash is with a rude employer who makes the new roof feel anything but safe.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A gentle newcomer with unusual hobbies wanders into the path of a local street gang.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The crew has plans for him, and their leader's interest turns a bad first meeting into something far more personal.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: When strange dungeons erupt worldwide, a man who can rebuild ruined cities watches friends twist into the undead.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A powerful hunter offers a grim partnership that may be his only way to face what his friends have become.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A girl raised by nobles discovers the sister she trusted has been trying to destroy her all along.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A failed suicide attempt flings her into the past, and the sister who once poisoned every day is suddenly missing from the timeline.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Only after his wife is gone does a ruler understand how badly he failed her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Magic sends him back to their first meeting so he can choose differently, but rewriting time warps more than he bargained for.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After decades saving the world from extradimensional threats, a veteran finally tries to quit.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The morning after his send-off, he finds himself young and powerless again, and this time he plans to get rich and quit fast using what he already knows.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An unwanted royal daughter keeps dying and waking at the start of the same miserable life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: On a later loop she learns who her real father is, and decides to use that distant war hero as her ticket out of the palace's fate.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An unexpected inheritance comes with one condition: keep a small restaurant running for years.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Late at night, resentful spirits arrive craving comfort food from their living days, and he has to feed their hunger and their unfinished business.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An overlooked noble daughter leaps at an arranged marriage meant for her sister, hoping status will finally stick.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her new husband cannot sleep because of a curse, and her rare ability to send him under with a kiss becomes a nightly contract that blurs into something else.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A teacher who believes everyone deserves an education accepts a post inside a notorious international prison.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A riot dumps him into the custody of a mysterious inmate, and escape means crawling through layered circles of institutional hell.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A future legend starts out as just another climber chasing something into a vast vertical trial.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Teammates and rivals share the climb with him, and the question becomes whether the thing he wants at the top is even waiting there.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After being murdered, a woman wakes inside a colleague's novel as an unremarkable daughter of a doomed house.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The whole family is racing toward a public execution, and she has to rewrite their fate before the blade falls on all of them.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A peak martial artist from one world crosses paths with a genius spellcaster from another.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When martial discipline and fantasy magic collide, neither side's rules quite survive the meeting.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An office worker reborn as a doomed witch vows to escape the lover who is meant to kill her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A sealed calamity inside the ruthless ruler only settles when she is near, so staying alive means mastering magic that can quiet his violence without sealing her own fate.

entries.title: I Can't Keep Up With My Stallion Duke

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a cold, lonely marriage, a wife wakes decades earlier and refuses to repeat the same empty life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She remarries a duke rumored to have no interest in women, hoping for quiet freedom, only to discover the rumor was wildly wrong.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young exam prodigy enters palace service expecting scholarly work and finds misery instead.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Between indulging a difficult royal and secretly training in martial arts, he eventually turns his brush toward conquering the martial world itself.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Years after monsters first hit the city, a man who never made the hero cut gets flung back to the beginning.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Armed with future knowledge and a second awakening, he dives into early dungeons determined to claim the power he once missed.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young woman muddles through love and work while her own feelings keep sabotaging the plan.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The comedy comes from watching those impulses argue, panic, and scheme as if they were coworkers stuck in the same cramped office.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: At rival schools, the most popular boys hide supernatural natures behind ordinary campus lives.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A mysterious transfer student draws both sides in, and as violence shakes the town, buried histories start cracking open.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Everyone warns her to stay away from a dangerous girl who somehow keeps pulling her attention.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A late-night motorcycle ride home turns curiosity into something hotter, and she starts doubting whether the rumors were ever true.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An underpaid secretary under a notoriously ruthless boss is ready to walk out.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She hits him with a marriage contract instead: one year of playing spouse in exchange for the money his parents need.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Dropped into a novel she once read, she marries the emperor just to stay safe and pampered.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The plot refuses to stay on script, spawning new faces and twists that threaten the careful role she planned to play.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The same hands that once held her lovingly become the ones that destroy her family.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She demands a divorce; he refuses, insisting she stay and suffer beside him, until old wounds drag them back together.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The country's youngest top-ranked awakener is still young enough for kindergarten.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When a quest tells her to find a guardian, she storms a major guild and forces its leader into an adoption he never saw coming.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A world-saving hero is betrayed by the person who raised her and gets a second life as a child.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: An old comrade, now a powerful duchess, takes her in, but unfinished revenge and a possible blood tie complicate any chance at a soft new family.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young woman facing an unwanted marriage makes a desperate bargain for escape.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The price of that wish pulls her toward the one person she was never supposed to want.

entries.title: Disobey the Duke if You Dare

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A widow is pushed into yet another political match with a feared warlord.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her new husband is unexpectedly gentle, but living with him means one hard rule: she must never look upon his face.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A weak kid from a famous fighter lineage remembers a past life inside a game world.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The new classmate who seems friendly is destined to ruin everything, so he decides friendship might be the only way to change the ending.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A dying surgeon wakes in another trainee's body with one last chance to practice medicine.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Invisible readouts show him every patient's condition, and he aims that edge at becoming an unmatched heart specialist.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An academy star used to coming first finds his streak and ego cracked by a newcomer.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She shrugs off the charms that usually work for him, and that indifference sticks in his head far longer than rivalry should.

entries.title: The Status Window to the Soul

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A lonely royal condemned for a crime she did not commit gets a second childhood instead of an ending.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She can see what people truly think, and those private truths rewrite who she trusts and how she tries to reshape her fate.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone wakes up inside the body of a notorious noblewoman with a second chance to undo the damage she caused.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her mother had twisted a gifted mage into loving her, and this time she wants him free even if that love disappears.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A princess with a title and almost no real power meets someone who offers a path to true standing.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His help comes with a price she cannot yet see, and climbing the court may cost more than she expects.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A lonely teen whose appearance keeps people away finally finds a friend at a new school.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After a brutal betrayal and a second chance, he rebuilds that bond on a carefully kept lie.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A girl hides in a noble household by living as a young male servant.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Growing feelings for the lord she serves and a watchful royal make keeping the disguise until adulthood a dangerous race.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A college student hides a rising online singing identity behind an ordinary campus life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When an idol wants to work with that persona, a shared class project keeps pulling the two worlds together.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A man wakes up as an infant in a faded martial clan, armed with memories from another life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Looking at training with fresh eyes, he rebuilds techniques from the ground up and pushes his school toward a new era.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A soft-hearted player keeps helping others in a ruthless online fantasy world.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A rare support class finally starts rewarding kindness with real power, but cutthroat players still surround him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The disregarded youngest of a powerful martial house dies after losing his core strength, then wakes earlier in life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Given another shot, he wants an easy life away from succession fights, not another race to be the clan's champion.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman hitting rock bottom after betrayal finds herself drawn to someone she never expected.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The person who stole her partner also clears the debt left behind, and that messy kindness turns into something romantic.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman finally gets land of her own and sets out to live the quiet rural life she always wanted.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her plot sits against the imperial grounds, and the ruler next door takes a sharp interest in what she is growing there.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A girl is installed as a holy figure to prop up a royal claim, knowing exposure means death.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She tries to slip away with divine help, only to draw the wrong eyes from the temple and the court instead.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A quiet princess accepts marriage to a feared warlord just to escape her miserable life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A curse swaps their bodies overnight, forcing each to navigate the other's duties until they can reverse it.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An obsessed fan finds daily comfort chatting with an account that pretends to be a beloved fictional role.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Those good morning and goodnight texts start feeling too personal, and the mystery of who is really typing pulls him into something riskier than fan chat.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A kind man spends years reshaping himself into what he thinks his crush wants.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When she admits she prefers rough types, he commits to reinventing his whole personality overnight.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A decorated soldier dies on the battlefield and wakes inside a romantic fantasy story.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Stuck as the heroine's loyal friend, she decides to rewrite that doomed supporting role rather than play along.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A stern career woman and a charming, clumsy junior keep clashing at the same company.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After a strange trip, they trade bodies for a set stretch each day and must cover for each other to protect their reputations.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A terminally ill orphan gets reborn into her favorite story as a cherished royal child.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A built-in curse still caps her years, so she tries to savor borrowed time while the plot keeps throwing new dangers at her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A society darling refuses a glittering match once she learns her fiancé has been unfaithful.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Seeing she was only a pawn, she seeks out a war hero her family once humiliated and tries to rebuild love without title or fortune.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A lonely adult brings home a wounded student who offers nightly cooking in exchange for a place to stay.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The food is excellent, but an uneasy sense that his guest is hiding something bloody keeps growing under their quiet arrangement.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After her world is destroyed, an immortal survivor sets out for revenge against the ruler behind it.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Stranded in a strange new realm, she must master unfamiliar powers before she can finish what she started.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a crushing friendzone, a night of drinking leaves a girl with a kiss she cannot remember.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Two classmates show matching marks the next day, and her quiet love life suddenly splits into two confusing possibilities.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A veteran player watches the virtual world he loves get twisted for corporate profit.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With a sharp AI partner, he sets out to sabotage the next season by steering the game toward the worst possible outcome.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A loyal imperial assassin is betrayed and executed, then wakes years earlier with a second chance.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She plans to tear apart the realm her former lord cherished, while an enemy prince who once ordered her death keeps stepping into her path.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An overworked mage from another planet flees into a stranger's body on a magic-rich Earth.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Posing as a local fighter, he has to adapt fast and hide what he really is from people seeking his old identity.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Mysterious structures full of monsters and promised power appear worldwide, and only chosen people may enter.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A timid young man who wanted to stay invisible gets selected anyway and must decide whether the risk is worth facing his fear.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A former aspiring fighter who settled for gang life dies with one regret left unfinished.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wakes in a world where combat sports rule, and finally chases the ring career he abandoned.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An entire city is yanked into a divine contest of monsters and staged challenges.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Working together is not enough; saving everyone may require becoming the most hated player on the board.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: During a world-ending monster disaster, a man is thrown decades into the past.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He takes his foster father's students under his wing, hoping to stop the apocalypse before it ever begins.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A modern soul reincarnates as the lowest child in a ruthless noble house.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Survival means stacking wealth and strength, and a chance meeting with a legendary poison expert pulls him toward the empire's darkest trade.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman who gave everything for the man she loved is cast aside the moment he takes the throne.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Poisoned and regretful, she returns to an earlier point and partners with the prince who actually mourned her to rewrite the ending.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After tragedy leaves her father a fugitive, a girl hides her identity to serve a reforming emperor.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He trains the supposed boy into a ruthless martial weapon, and the bond between them grows more complicated as she searches for a life of her own.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A school couple everyone still sees as perfect has already quietly split.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Stuck representing their class at a dance festival, they fake the relationship until the show ends and start doubting the breakup.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A gifted thief and a boy with a buried past set their sights on joining an elite knight order.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The entrance trials pit them against aristocratic prodigies, and surviving selection is only the beginning of a crueler fate.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Offered a chance to rewind his life, a man chooses to start over from the day he was born.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: While the world is still calm, he plans to lock down wealth and every dungeon he can before chaos arrives.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: When monsters pour through the sky, gifted fighters become humanity's last line, trained in elite schools.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A student with a weak ranking attribute still pushes to climb the most prestigious academy in the world.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Running a simple errand, a boy and everyone nearby suddenly shrink to insect scale.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Everyday objects become lethal, and a personal ability plus a data readout are all he has to survive and reach his sister.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A stressed high school senior agrees to beta test a VR game and ends up unable to log out.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Death only restarts the loop in a dark fantasy world built by a company whose motives stay murky.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a childhood captivity ends, a rescued boy reenters ordinary life with an unsettling gift.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Tiny expressions tell him everyone's true feelings, and that clarity makes the quiet existence he wants almost impossible.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A driven trainee keeps losing chances at debut over a school scandal he did not commit.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A strange gift from an agency head reshapes his appearance overnight, and the industry suddenly starts seeing someone it wants to cast.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After years of being useful in the background, a support fighter is cast out of his guild.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A rare elemental contract gives him a new edge, and he takes that second chance to an underdog crew fighting monsters and rivals.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young woman trapped in a loveless match finds an unexpected invitation that offers a way out.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Inside a glittering imperial circle of gemstone titles, she finds unlikely allies and a shot at the affection she never had.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Two quiet students start a fragile friendship through a school project neither expected to need.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: One of them claims a black sludge answers to anxiety, and learning to trust each other means facing that hostility together.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After her boss is murdered, a rising criminal operative swears revenge on the tycoon who ordered it.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Blocked from reaching him directly, she infiltrates the elite school his heir attends as a last desperate move.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A drought-stricken village offers a girl as a sacrifice to a divine being they fear.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead of dying, she is welcomed into a magical realm where the deity is nothing like the monster she expected.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A nobleman whose magic makes everyone adore him finds the gift isolating, and rival houses want him gone.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After a raid on an enemy estate, one captured maid turns out immune to the compulsion that controls everyone else.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young heir watches his family slaughtered by a rival blade master and inherits a buried bloodline gift.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A guiding ancestor teaches him to claim power from fallen weapons, inheriting skill and memory as he climbs toward revenge.

entries.title: The Roguish Guard in a Medieval Fantasy

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A castle guard captain hunts corruption as demons twist men's hearts and threaten the lady he protects.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A mark from one of them grants him terrifying strength while dark magic clouds his mind and body.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A grieving musician stumbles into a chance meeting that pulls him toward something not quite human.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After hearing the person who always comforted him loves someone else, he draws the interest of a mythical beast that should ignore humans.

entries.title: Adopted by a Murderous Duke Family

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A girl exploited for her healing gift dies in captivity and wakes years earlier, desperate to rewrite her fate.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She chooses a notorious household of assassins as her new home and hides the power that once made her a target.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a funeral, an elderly man decides it is not too late to chase a dream everyone around him finds absurd.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A young instructor and fellow dreamers help him train for an art form he never got to try, proving passion still matters late in life.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A legendary hunter who sealed a great evil spends a century trapped in another world before clawing a way home.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He returns with a strange partner to find only a decade passed on Earth, his name erased, and his disciples gone from history.

entries.title: Trapped at Home With the Male Leads

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reborn as a wealthy heiress, a girl realizes the world is ending and starts spending furiously to stay alive.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The shelter she builds against the monsters ends up housing the novel's romantic leads as well, forcing uneasy cooperation.

entries.title: Hiding a Warehouse in the Apocalypse

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: When the world collapses, a young man gains a strange power that lets him stash anything in another space.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Venturing into a ruined capital for his family, he finds other survivors and creatures that suggest the disaster is not what it seems.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A college-bound student dies in an accident and wakes as a noble heir tied to an empire's ancient champions.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Uncontrollable magic, elemental spirits, and a returning evil force her to grow into the role the bloodline demands.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A child with nothing left to hope for crosses paths with a harsh old stranger.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Abuse has emptied her world, and the unlikely bond that forms is anything but soft or sentimental.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Top of the class and dead last are forced to share a month on camera for a school documentary.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Opposite personalities start revealing hidden depths as the project traps them in each other's company.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a realm of chaos, knights and rulers clash in a struggle that continues after an earlier war.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The focus stays entirely in that darker world, where a new figure of power reshapes who holds the throne.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A year after a brother's death from bullying, a younger sibling returns to school carrying quiet fury.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He sets out to dismantle the delinquent network that destroyed his family, one fight at a time.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a world of hunters, a boy awakens with no usable trait and seems doomed to stay useless.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A strange feed of divine powers starts unlocking abilities he never had, and he uses them to claw into hunter society.

entries.title: Why Are You Obsessed With Your Fake Wife?

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Betrayed by family and fiancé, a woman wakes in the past with one goal: make them pay.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She marries the icy northern lord her relatives always mistreated, planning cold revenge that may thaw into something else.

entries.title: The Gardener in a Hunter World

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A low-tier hunter scrapes by selling potions until a nap on an ancient text opens a door he never expected.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A magical forest yields rare ingredients and mythical allies as he builds an alchemy career that catches elite attention.

entries.title: The Carefree Life of an SSS-Class Knight

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ordinary man wants nothing to do with the new age of powered beings until a mysterious message changes everything.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Overnight he becomes a rare high-tier knight, and the only way to survive the attention is to keep leveling up.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A girl with no memories endures years of abuse in a baron's house until a feared emperor takes interest in her eyes.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Whisked into a gothic court of blood and obsession, she wonders if the man who took her also holds the key to her forgotten past.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young woman carries a grim second sight that shows endings before they happen.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: An injured royal in her yard shifts the fates of everyone nearby, and she follows him toward the capital with a terrible personal stake.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Knowing a novel dooms her as a lookalike sacrifice, a girl tries to flee the man prophesied to kill her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She saves him instead and ends up taken into the very household she feared, spoiled and wondering if the ending changed.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Locked away as a cursed child, a royal heir is sold abroad instead of fulfilling the destiny she was born for.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Under a young knight's care she plots revenge for her mother's death, torn between soft feelings and cold payback.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a land that shuns magic users, a maid grows uneasy about a new servant who seems far too polished for his rank.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Strange incidents at the manor push her into sleuthing, and the estate's safety may hang on what she uncovers.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A sharp-minded heir with a failing heart never earns his family's respect no matter how hard he tries.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After an accident, he wakes in a battered student's body and must rebuild a life from someone else's leftovers.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A sharp-tongued teacher and a gentle florist keep getting misread by everyone around them.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Shared love of cats pulls the unlikely pair together in a bright romantic comedy of mismatched looks and soft hearts.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A quiet freshman meant to leave a high-school crush behind discovers they enrolled at the same college.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Shared campus life stirs old feelings and new ones as their paths keep crossing.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A northern woman betrayed by her southern lover is thrown from a cliff and offered a second chance by a witch.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She returns years later in a new body without a voice, aided by an apothecary while hostile villagers reject the outsider.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A bit-part actor finds the film set turning into lived reality the moment the camera rolls.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He can only escape each take by nailing the perfect performance, feeling every wound until the director cuts.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Under a military regime, a slave begins a climb that will remake him into a commander.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: From the bottom of the social order he fights through rebellion and war toward a general's rank.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A wallflower discovers the school's golden boy is just as socially awkward behind the polished image.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Forced together by chance, the two shy outsiders learn friendship, and maybe something more, in quiet steps.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A notorious lowlife suddenly reforms, because an author now wears the body of the scoundrel he wrote.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Trapped in his own martial novel, he recruits allies and former foes to build enough strength to escape a scripted death.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An anonymous online legend loses everything when his character is permanently deleted in the game he lived for.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When that game bleeds into reality, he gets a second start packed with rare abilities no one else can see coming.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A struggling artist in colonial-era Seoul accepts a portrait commission from a reclusive madam no one else has seen.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She appears impossibly young and warns him not to finish, while earlier painters left her house dead or broken.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An author wakes inside her own novel as a minor painter doomed to die by the feared prince's hand.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Colorblind and branded by a bloody prophecy, he needs the destined counterpart she must find before fate hardens him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A holy knight investigates rumored war prep across a peace treaty and stumbles into trafficking in his own country.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Another person sharing his rare power keeps pulling him closer, while a foreign king's knight hunt seems aimed at someone specific.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Knowing the grandson she was raised to marry will kill her, a noble girl bargains for a future divorce instead.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: As she plans a free life after adulthood, his feelings deepen and danger tightens around the arrangement she thought would save her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Endlessly reborn, a girl watches the demon king destroy the world in every life she lives.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: This time she wakes as his newborn lookalike daughter among the same minions who murdered her before, waiting for revenge.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young duke's heir sets out to see the world and feels drawn to a shabby boy among his travel companions.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The companion is a disguised princess fleeing a violent betrothal, and their bond risks sparking war.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Stuck for years in a brutally hard game world, a possessed player must prevent the ending's collapse to go home.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Claiming fallen soldiers' bodies lets him inherit their stats and skills as he pushes toward a clear ending.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A man wakes in a hospital with no memories and a stranger claiming to be his lover.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The only scrap he recalls of that man is an attempt on his life, and he cannot tell which story is true.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A student tracks dreams and premonitions that keep coming true in terrifying ways.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Pages she does not remember writing appear, and her school plunges into a nightmare she has to piece together to survive.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A student aiming for ordinary college is dragged into another dimension's academy instead.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Survival means climbing a legendary tower tied to his bloodline while rivals, monsters, and traps try to end the ascent.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A high schooler with a fiery curse needs someone whose nature runs equally cold to break it.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The only cure is a kiss on the right person's lips, and finding that match through campus chaos is half the battle.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A discharged soldier wasting his days on games gets pulled into a lethal arena that looks like one he played.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Martial masters, otherworldly kings, and killers fill the roster, and his only goal is lasting long enough to crack the top tier.

entries.title: Can't Take My Eyes Off You!

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A broke young man lands an overpaid job managing a top celebrity who everyone seems to adore too much.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Fans, staff, and even the agency feel unnaturally devoted, and the idol cannot understand why the new manager alone is immune.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A deposed heir who barely survives a bloody succession war wakes with two legendary martial souls sharing his body.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Fused into something stronger than either master alone, he begins a climb toward absolute supremacy through the martial world.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A practical orphan wants nothing to do with superstition until his sixteenth birthday rewrites his ordinary life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A classmate's sudden confession pulls him into spirit chases and a hidden world he never believed existed.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A former top ranker trapped in a brutal VR game finds his old stats are nowhere near enough.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Random rewards keep breaking in his favor so hard that gambling systems and loot rolls become his real build.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An undefeated fighting legend dies at the top of his sport and wakes as a child in a martial world without rules.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: In a realm where only strength decides who lives, he sets out to climb back to champion the hard way.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A cherished princess is betrayed by her brother and left dying beside their father.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Reborn as a sacred fox, she sets out to expose the conspiracy that stole her first life.
